intentPolicy: Only implemented user tasks may be claimed on tool pages. This document is evidence triage, not approval to create pages or change canonical/index policy. Optional geometrical modes must distinguish user-supplied independently verified maximum OC from structural code recommendations.

primary.scope: Broad 'stud calculator' also serves straight-wall stud counting; this route models only a single-slope rake wall. The existing wall-stud-calculator is a different task.
primary.notFor: A full two-sided gable in one calculation, a straight wall stud count, or framing structural approval.

primary.scope: Broad 'framing calculator' may include other types of framing; this route calculates straight wall framing with door/window openings, not structural sizing or picture framing.
primary.notFor: An engineering-approved header span, bearing design, or permit drawing.

primary.scope: Calculate parallel deck board rows, gaps, and the final rip width.
primary.notFor: A full deck frame, joist span, post or footing design.

primary.scope: Distribute balusters with explicit clear gaps and center positions.
primary.notFor: Proof of local railing, child-safety, or structural-code compliance.

primary.scope: Broad 'rafter calculator' may mean spacing, count or sizing; this route solves common rafter line and birdsmouth geometry, not approved spacing or design.
primary.notFor: A hip-rafter cut, engineered span, load rating, or approved roof assembly.

primary.scope: Find compound miter and bevel reference angles for crown molding.
primary.notFor: Proof of saw orientation, material spring angle, or a verified test cut.

primary.scope: Calculate an eave-section soffit drop with the defined thickness offsets.
primary.notFor: Structural design for rafter tails, fascia fastening or roof ventilation.

primary.scope: Generic 'kerf calculator' may mean material kerf allowance; this page is specifically for kerf-bending slot geometry.

primary.scope: Divide a wall into repeatable wainscoting panel bays and margins.
primary.notFor: Wall framing, molding compound cuts, or an installed structural design.

primary.scope: Calculate level-finished straight stairs with optional measured deck tread coverage and limited available-flight-run checks.
primary.notFor: Stringer bearing strength, spiral stairs or building-code approval.

primary.scope: Convert rise, run and slope angle for a straight reference line.
primary.notFor: Full roof cuts, stair step counts, or structural clearance checks.

primary.scope: Generic 'deck estimator' may mean deck cost, joist spans, footings or complete framing; this tool calculates measured decking takeoff and limited joist reference quantities only.
primary.notFor: Selecting structurally permitted joist spacing or span, engineer-approved post/footing/beam loads, deck certification or prescribed fastener attachment.

primary.scope: Compute segmented bowl ring geometry and reference segment cutting angles.
primary.notFor: Wood species machinability, glue-joint strength or lathe safety.

primary.scope: Generic 'pitch calculator' has non-roof interpretations; this tool is exclusively roof slope, degrees, rise/run and grade.
primary.notFor: Rafter birds-mouth geometry, hip-roof panel cuts or structural approval.

primary.scope: Place precise measured part centers, or solve the number of parts from maximum face clearance or desired center-to-center spacing.
primary.notFor: Thickness-aware shelf clearances, railing code or drilling hardware limits.

primary.scope: Calculate hip-rafter diagonal run and pitched line reference geometry.
primary.notFor: A complete hip roof sheathing layout, birdsmouth, or engineered timber.

primary.scope: Broad 'hip roof calculator' may imply structural framing or all material costs; this page calculates modeled surface/sheathing polygon geometry only.
primary.notFor: A complete structural hip roof truss or verified on-site saw program.

primary.scope: Count and position studs in a straight, level wall reference.
primary.notFor: Door and window King/Jack framing or sloped rake-wall stud lengths.

primary.scope: Calculate shelf clearances and optional pin-hole coordinate references.
primary.notFor: Hardware load capacity, shelf sag limits or a 1:1 drill jig.

primary.scope: Estimate a symmetric gable roof's slope lengths and surface area.
primary.notFor: Hip or valley roof cuts, sheathing nesting, or a structural roof design.

primary.scope: Compare diagonals when setting out a rectangle or foundation footprint.
primary.notFor: Structural footing design, concrete volume or a survey-grade report.

primary.scope: Compute reference diagonal length and angle between two measured legs.
primary.notFor: Engineered diagonal bracing resistance or an approved load path.

primary.scope: Calculate repeated hole centers and edge offsets for a drilling line.
primary.notFor: A calibrated drill jig, fastener edge-distance code or shelf loading.

primary.scope: Compute nominal straight stringer notches and modeled side-profile stations.
primary.notFor: Approved bearing cuts, structural stringer capacity or spiral stairs.

primary.scope: Estimate roof panel pieces and optional sheet-stock bounding-box reuse.
primary.notFor: Hip valley panel cuts outside the entered geometry or an approved roof nailing schedule.

primary.scope: Count fence posts and calculate their center locations along a run.
primary.notFor: Fence picket layout, post embedment or wind-load structural design.

primary.scope: Broad spiral staircase intent may require code, headroom, central-column and engineered stringer design; this is a single-turn measured wedge/reference model only.
primary.notFor: Stair headroom or guardrail approval, multi-turn stair design, code compliance, structural bearing, pole selection or finished shop cuts.

primary.scope: Calculate symmetric two-pitch gambrel section geometry, knuckle stations, ridge height and surface areas of four roof segments.
primary.notFor: Structural gambrel truss loads or joints, timber span design, bearing cuts, sheet nesting or roofing code certification.

primary.scope: Historical 'price per thousand calculator' lacks a lumber/MBF qualifier and may refer to generic per-1000 unit prices. The live page covers board-foot volume and optional BF/MBF lumber quotes; do not claim the broad query is served. Verify a lumber-qualified target term separately.
primary.notFor: A generic price per 1,000 items, hardwood market price feed, tree/log scaling, actual dressed-size lookup, or a verified cutting/purchase order.

primary.scope: Lay out measured fence picket face edges and equal clear gaps, then optionally calculate a separate stepped top-cut height for each straight board.
primary.notFor: A structural fence span, curved cutting template, post embedment, safe pool barrier openings or approved wind-loading design.

primary.scope: Broad 'stave calculator' may include drums, cooperage and curved barrels; this page handles straight trapezoid faces in a tapered polygon-frustum barrel reference only.
primary.notFor: A barrel bulge, guaranteed inner capacity, proven table-saw compound bevel or certified coopering and hardwood stock purchasing.

flagged.keyword: wall framing calculator with windows and doors
flagged.reason: Already supported: measured openings and King/Jack/header/sill on the framing calculator. Never claim it on the plain wall-stud route.

Publicly accessible pages for the exact phrase predominantly show one-wall stud/plate estimates with door and window openings. The existing Framing Calculator does support user-entered opening stations, king/jack/header/sill member geometry and stock takeoff; the Wall Stud Counter does not. This is a qualified existing route, NOT structural header sizing, code-certified wall plans, or a verified USA-geolocated Top-10 SERP match.

Structural span depends on span tables, size, grade/species, loading, wet-service and code edition. Not safely supplied by material takeoff; independent standards and qualified review required before considering any tool.
Search seeks complete framing plan, unlike this roof-line geometry; a documented field guide would need professional scope review, not a hidden keyword insertion.
User wants enclosed 3D volume; hip rafter reference-line geometry does not calculate that volume. Low evidence priority; verify SERP and inputs before a feature.
Hip-to-gable conversion is a different roof conversion geometry/design task, not the gable surface-area tool; do not claim it.
Load-bearing bracket spacing/shelf sag requires material/stiffness/load and fixings; shelf-clearance and pin positions cannot substitute.

Independent coopering/coopered-stave calculators show top and bottom diameters, staves, height, taper/bevel and sometimes thickness, stock fit and curved barrels. The existing Stave Calculator handles only a straight-sided polygon frustum's trapezoid face geometry. It is related to a NARROW subtask, NOT a complete cooperage/barrel-volume/curved-stave solution. Do not market the broad phrase as an equivalent keyword. These public examples are not a verified geographically located US SERP.
This is a practical tutorial and material-safety question, not a specific kerf geometry calculation; keep out of calculator metadata without researched editorial guidance.
